shared_elements: low relief carving on stone surface
horizontal band of repeated parallel elements (fringe/ribbing)
justification: Both are low reliefs that include a profile head with a large emphasized eye and a horizontal band of closely repeated parallel strokes (a fringe or ribbed register), which is the most specific correspondence, but that band is generic. A shows a single large naturalistically modelled human head with curled beard and hair rendered as dense spirals, while B shows a stack of schematic animal figures — quadrupeds in a row above, snake-like and bird-like creatures below — in stacked registers with no human element, so subject matter and composition differ almost completely.
